implementation: Normal builds do not compile verification window settings; verification build without window args keeps the normal config path.

Use the same generated Tauri production Context and original main-window config; suppress only its automatic creation for verification, then explicitly build it with WebView2 API data_directory/additional_browser_args.
Fixed arguments retain locked wry0.57 defaults and allow only127.0.0.1; no arbitrary browser switches, no system registry changes, no runtime downgrade or security disabling.
Python removes inherited user-data/browser-argument overrides from that child environment and supplies the numeric port through the verified CLI.
CDP attempts have individual2s/overall30s bounds, retain the last exception and attempt count, and close an attached browser if its checkpoint cannot be saved.

Windows preflight now records registered runtime versions and actual elevation; failed native launch captures parent/window state before owned cleanup and surfaces the desktop log tail. Successful CDP attachment also records the actual browser version.
